43: Me’od (“Greatly”). Tiferet from the side of Gevurah.
Me’or Gadol (“The Greater Light”; the sun). Tiferet.
Me’or Katan (“The Lesser Light”; the moon). Malkhut.
Me’orot (“Lights”). [May refer to] the side of holiness or [that of] impurity.
Migdal (“Tower”). Binah or Malkhut or Keter.
Middat ha-Din ha-Kasha (“The Harsh Quality of Judgment”). Gevurah.
Middat ha-Din ha-Rafah (“The Mild Quality of Judgment”). Malkhut.
Mah (“What”). Ḥokhmah or Tiferet or Malkhut.
Mosdei Ereḥ (“Foundations of the Land”). The Righteous [Yesod] and Righteousness.
Mo’ed (“Appointed Time”). The six “directions”.22The six “directions” are the six sefirot from Gedulah to Yesod.
Moshel (“Ruler”). Tiferet from the side of Yesod.
Mezuzah (“Doorpost”). Malkhut from the side of Tiferet.
Maḥshavah (“Thought”). Eyn Sof, Keter, Ḥokhmah, Binah.
Maḥshof ha-Lavan (“The White Exposed Place” [Gen. 30:37]). Keter or Tiferet.
Matronah (“Lady”). [The division of] Creation, or Malkhut.
Malakh (“Angel”). Malkhut. [Malkhut is also referred to by the terms] melukhah (“kingdom”) and malon (“dwelling place”).
Melekh Shelomoh (“King Solomon”). Tiferet or Binah or Ḥokhmah.
Mamlekhet Kohanim (“Kingdom of Priests” [Exod. 19:6]). Malkhut with Tiferet.
Menorah (“Lamp). Shekhinah, [which is also referred to by the words] minḥah (“gift”) and mispar (“number”).
Ma’ayan (“Spring”). The three first [sefirot] and the three last [sefirot].
Ma’ayanei ha-Yeshuah (“Wells of Salvation”), Ḥokhmah and Binah, Ḥesed and Gevurah.
Ma’arakhab (“Army”). Binah or Malkhut. [These are also referred to by the term] ma’aseh (“deed”).
Ma’aseh Merkavah (“Account of the Chariot”). Metatron.
Ma’aseh Bereshit (“Account of Creation”). Malkhut [which is also referred to by the term] ma’aser (“tithe”).
Miẓuveh (“One Who Is Commanded”). Tiferet and Yesod.
Meẓulot Yam (“Depths of the Sea”). Kelipah.
Mikveh (“Source of Water”). Malkhut and Tiferet.
Mikneh (“Cattle”). From the side of Malkhut.
Merkavah (“Chariot”). Any [group of] four sefirot is called merkavah.
Matok (“Sweet”). Malkhut from the side of Gevurah.
Mattan Torah (“Giving of the Torah”). Binah.
